$comment: What the app does to a source's display text before showing it — SourceText.kt, applied field by field in ContractDtos.toDomain(). `removed` code points go from every field below; `spaced` ones become one space in a `line` field (a CR LF pair becoming one) and stay in a `prose` one. Code points as inclusive ranges rather than a regex, so the two hosts' regex dialects cannot read them differently, and in decimal because JSON has no hex: 8234-8238 is U+202A-U+202E and 8294-8297 is U+2066-U+2069. Fields are named by the shape of the answer they are in, whichever method returned it. doctor reads this to tell an author what a television will change (kangzj/lantern-tv#487), and DisplayTextRecordTest holds the app to it in both directions: every field listed is cleaned, and no field left out is. Change the app and this together.
